## Population Health & Cardiovascular Disease

Population health examines how social, economic, environmental, and behavioral conditions influence health outcomes across communities. Understanding these factors is essential to identifying cardiovascular health disparities and developing effective public health interventions.

::: info-card
Explore diabetes, hypertension, poor diet, and other contributing factors that influence cardiovascular health and disease risk.
:::
